title: Multimodal AI Systems
summary: Engineer systems that combine documents, images, audio, and realtime interaction with modality-aware pipelines, evaluation, safety, and user experience.
outcomes: Choose native multimodal models or staged specialist pipelines based on evidence and constraints
Build document pipelines that preserve layout, tables, provenance, and confidence
Design vision, speech, and realtime interactions around latency, interruption, and fallback
Evaluate multimodal quality and safety by modality, segment, and end-to-end task outcome

lessons.title: Document AI: OCR, layout, tables, and extraction
